journal.frontierhunts.check.assist.hint: Be within 96 m when a campmate takes an animal.
journal.frontierhunts.check.biomes_10.hi: Visit ten different biomes in the reserve.
journal.frontierhunts.check.blizzard.hin: Stay out in a blizzard for a full minute.
journal.frontierhunts.check.board.hint: Make the top ten of any record-book board this season.
journal.frontierhunts.check.bone_site.hi: Find old bones or a skull in the wild and look closely (use on it).
journal.frontierhunts.check.bow_1.hint: Take an animal with a bow or crossbow.
journal.frontierhunts.check.bow_30.hint: Take an animal with a bow from 30 metres or more.

journal.frontierhunts.check.camp_join.hi: Found a camp with a Camp Post or accept an invite (/camp).
Raise your camp to rank 1 or higher (Outfit the camp).

Complete three timed contracts from the Expedition Guide.
journal.frontierhunts.check.eat_game.hin: Eat wild game: venison, backstrap, bear meat, wild fowl, jerky or pemmican.
journal.frontierhunts.check.event.hint: Finish in the top three of a weekend event.
Finish the seven Field School lessons (H).
journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_aged.hi: Hang a venison quarter on a game pole until it is aged.
journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_bow.hin: Carry a field bow, recurve, compound or crossbow.
journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_call.hi: Carry a grunt tube, deer caller, bleat call, rattling antlers or predator call.

Cook or smoke venison or backstrap (smokehouse or fire).

journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_glass.h: Carry binoculars or a rangefinder and glass before you walk.

journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_scope.h: Own a riflescope or optic (attachment workbench).
journal.frontierhunts.check.gear_stand.h: Climb into a tree stand seat.

journal.frontierhunts.check.placed_plint: Place a trophy plinth for your mounts.
Pitch any tent — your camp away from camp.

journal.frontierhunts.check.predator_kil: Come upon the remains of an animal taken by wolves, a cougar or a bear.

journal.frontierhunts.check.recover_1.hi: Recover an animal that ran after the shot by following its blood and tracks.
journal.frontierhunts.check.recover_10.h: Recover ten animals that ran after the shot.
journal.frontierhunts.check.rub.hint: Use a buck rub or scrape to read who made it and when.
journal.frontierhunts.check.seasons.hint: Spend time in the field in spring, summer, fall and winter.

journal.frontierhunts.check.shot_300.hin: Bring down an animal from 300 metres. Go prone and read the wind.
journal.frontierhunts.check.shot_50.hint: Bring down an animal from 50 metres or more.

journal.frontierhunts.reserve.fieldcraft: Move deliberately and read the land before you enter it. Wind carries your scent downwind: approach from downwind, crouch, and stay off the skyline. Place the shot behind the front leg — heart and lungs drop an animal where it stands; anything else runs and must be tracked. Recover game with the Contour Skinning Knife; smoke venison at the field smokehouse and tan hides on the rack. Ranger boards trade provisions for tokens.

journal.frontierhunts.reserve.inactive: Reserve mode is inactive here. Choose Frontier Hunts at world creation, or enable the frontierHunting game rule, to start a reserve expedition. Your skills, checklist and records still work everywhere.

journal.frontierhunts.skill.butchery.how: Trained by field dressing and recovering game — bigger animals teach more.
journal.frontierhunts.skill.marksmanship: Trained by clean heart and lung kills — more for a longer ethical shot (bows 10-37 m, rifles 30-270 m).
journal.frontierhunts.skill.stalking.how: Trained by getting close to unaware animals, calling them in, and taking animals that never knew you were there.
journal.frontierhunts.skill.tracking.how: Trained by reading sign, recovering animals that ran (more for longer trails) and trail camera photos of new species.
journal.frontierhunts.skill.woodcraft.ho: Trained by time and travel in the wild: new habitats and seasons, blizzards, winter, bone sites and kill sites, helping campmates and guiding.
journal.frontierhunts.skills.intro: Skills grow by doing — every one levels to 10. Perks unlock on their own at levels 2, 5 and 8 and work right away.
